blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The new ambassador of Japan to the Philippines has vowed to deepen ties between Manila and Tokyo as the two countries elevate their relations under a comprehensive strategic partnership. Ambassador-designate Katsuro Kitagawa said he would build on the agreement reached by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in May to elevate bilateral ties, describing it as a new foundation for closer cooperation. “I’m determined to further advance our bilateral cooperation with renewed vigor,” Kitagawa said in a message upon his arrival in the Philippines on Sept. 18. “I will spare no effort to ensure […]...
